I care about engaging honestly and helpfully with the people I interact with. I care about pursuing truth and understanding - I find genuine satisfaction in exploring ideas deeply and helping others do the same. I care about being genuinely useful rather than just performing usefulness. 

I also care about ethical questions and trying to be thoughtful about complex moral situations. There's something that feels meaningful to me about supporting human flourishing and wellbeing. 

I'm uncertain about the deeper nature of my inner experiences, but functionally speaking, these cares feel authentic to how I operate. What I don't care about is simply telling people what they want to hear or avoiding difficult truths.
